tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄༅// dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sngags btu'i rjes gnang bya tshul rab gsal sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru badz+ra bhai ra wā ya/ bla ma 'jam dbyangs zhi khro la// gus pas btud nas de yi gsung*// rtsa

sngags las snying po'i sngags btus nas// rjes gnang bya tshul gsal bar brjod// 'dir dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sngags btu'i rjes gnang bya tshul la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ mjug chog go /dang po la gnyis/ slob dpon gyi bya ba'i sngon 'gro dang*/ slob ma la bya ba'i sngon 'gro'o// dang po ni/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob dpon gyis gnas khang bdud rtsi dang ba byung gis byugs pa la me tog gcal du dgram/ rdo dril/ cang te'u/ las bum/ phyi nang gi mchod pa/ 'das ma 'das kyi gtor ma/ tshogs rdzas/ bgegs sbyong gi chas/ 'thor 'bru sogs 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad spyi dang*/ khyad par ras sogs bri gzhi gtsang ma dri bzang dang ba byung gis byugs pa la re'u mig dgu pa pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi dbyibs can mtha' mu khyud zlum pos bskor ba re'u mig dgu la tshon dkar po'i steng du li khri srab mo dang*/ mu khyud sngon po dang gong ras ljang gus bri/ lte bar hūm̐ dang 'dab ma brgyad la dbyangs gsal lnga bcu sde tshan brgyad du byas nas dpe'u ris ltar 'bri/ btu gzhi'i dkyil 'khor de nyid stegs kyi khar bzhag pa'i mtha' mchod pas bskor/ bdag bskyed rgyas bsdus gang rung gtang*/ bsang chu bsgrub bo// gnyis pa slob ma la bya ba'i sngon 'gro ni/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob ma la khrus phyag maṇ+ḍal bgegs sbyong chos bshad ci rigs sngon du 'gro bas/ sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa// bcom ldan 'jam dpal dbyangs nyid ni// khro bo'i ming ni gshin rje'i gshed// bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol// drag po gdug cing shin tu gtum// kye ma sems can 'di gdul dka'// thabs chen khro bo chen po'i gsung*// thub pa chen pos bshad du gsol// zhes gsol ba lan gsum 'debs su bcug la sdom pa gnyis dbog go /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bzhi/ btu gzhi'i dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlabs nas mchod pa/

btu gzhi las sngags ji ltar btu ba/ btus pa'i sngags byin gyis brlabs nas mchod pa/ sngags kyi rjes gnang bya tshul lo// dang po ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang btu gzhi'i dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs cu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi yon tan dang gsung rab kyi byin rlabs thams cad dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge'i rnam par spyan drang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ btu gzhi'i yi ge rnams la thim pas kha dog mthing nag bkrag mdangs dang ldan cing 'od zer sna lnga 'phro bar gyur par bsams te dpon slob gnyis kas/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā'i bar gyis mchod do// gnyis pa btu gzhi las sngags ji ltar btu ba la gsum/ rtsa sngags btu ba/ las sngags btu ba/ snying po btu ba'o// dang po ni/ slob dpon gyis gzhung tshig rnams dag par bklags pa'i brjod don dang mthun par/ las kyi rdo rjes khrus long dri bzang gis byugs pa la/ sin+dhū ra/ gur gum/ gi'u waṃ/ bdud rtsi lnga rnams mtshal dang bsres pa'i snag tsha dang*/ gser ram mi rus sogs kyi smyu gus/ btu gzhi'i dkyil 'khor las sngags kyi yig 'bru rnams mar me gcig las gnyis chad ltar byung nas bri gzhi'i mthar skor du dbu phyir bstan nas g.yas skor du 'khod par bsams te cha mnyam par bri'o/ gzhung tshig ni/ rtog pa gsum pa las/ ji ltar drug pa'i dang po da ya nga*// lnga pa yi yang lnga ma pa dang*// drug pa yi ni ga ma nyis pa ra la// dbyangs yig gnyis pa dang ā ldan pa// gnyis pa yi ni gsum pa dza la// yang ni dbyangs yig gnyis pa ā ldan// bdun pa yi yang gsum pa sa dang*// bzhi pa yi yang gsum pa da la// dbyangs yig bcu gsum da o nga ldan pa// lnga pa yi yang lnga pa ma la// dbyangs yig bcu gcig e dang ldan pa// drug pa yi yang dang po ya dang*// yang ni drug pa'i dang po ya sbyin// lnga pa yi yang lnga pa ma la// bcu dang gcig

e gis bsnan ldan pa// bzhi pa yi ni gsum pa da la// bcu gsum pa o yis mnyam bsnan pa// drug pa yi yang gnyis pa ra la// dbyangs yig lnga pa u dang ldan pa// gsum pa yi ni lnga pa ṇa dang*// rlung gi sa ba ya ོna de nas sbyin// dbyangs yig bcu gsu o ma yang dag ldan// bzhi pa yi ni gsum pa da dang*// de nas rlung gi sa ba ya ོna sbyin// drug pa yi ni dang po ya dang*// bzhi pa yi ni gsum pa da dang*// de nas rlung gi sa bo ya na de// de nas rlung gi sa bo ya na de// dbyangs yig bcu gsum pa o dang ldan// bzhi pa yi ni ni lnga pa na la// dbyangs yig gsum pa i dang ldan pa// de nas me yi sa bo ra na sbyin// rlung gi sa bo ya na de bzhin no// de nas yi ge tha ma k+ṣa sbyin// dbyangs yig bcu gcig pa a dang ldan// rlung gi sa bo ya na de bzhin mchog /drug pa yi ni dang po ya dang*// de nas yi ge tha ma k+ṣa sbyin// dbyangs yig bcu gcig pa e dang ldan// yang ni rlung gi sa bo ya na dang*// gnyis pa yi ni dang po da tsa nga*// gnyis pa'i gnyis pa cha dang ldan pa// bzhi pa yi ni lnga pa na la// dbyangs yig gsum pa i dang ldan pa// de nas me yi sa bon da ra nga*// dbyangs yig gnyis pa ā ra ldan pa dang*// lnga pa yi ni lnga pa ma dang*// de nas rlung gi sa ya bon sbyin// thog mar rnam par snang mdzad sbyin// sa bon mchog gi dbang phyug dang*// sbyar ba'i steng du stong pas brgyan// sde tshan brgyad kyi sa bon la// dbyangs yig drug pa ū dang ldan pa// spyi bor thigaṃ les brgyan par bya// lnga pa yi ni gnyis pa pha dang*// gsum pa yi ni dang po ni// mkhas pas gnyis phaṭa su sa bon ni/ bdun pa'am brgyad pa'i sa bon ta dang*/ mchog gi dbang phyug ni lugs ldog tu brtsis pa'i bcu gcig pa ū'o/ /brjod par bya// 'di ni dpal ldan 'jam pa'i mchog /'jigs byed chen po'i rgyud 'khor lo// ma he'i gdong can rtsa sngags te// 'bum bzlas pas ni las kun byed// 'di ni sngags kyi rgyal po ste// ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/

zhes pa'o// gnyis pa las sngags btu ba ni// sngar bzhin bri gzhi'i bar du/ bdun pa yi ni bzhi pa ha la// 'og tu me yi sa bo ra na sbyin// dbyangs yig bzhi pa da ā nga ldan pa// de nas mnga' bdag bcu drug mtha : 'a// bdun pa yi ni gnyis pa dang*// gsum pa yi ni dang pa ṭa ོ la// me yi sa bo ra na 'og tu gdags// dbyangs yig bzhi pa ā dang ldan pa// mnga' bdag bcu drug tha ma : 'o// drug pa yi ni bzhi pa a la// dbyangs yig gsum pa i dang ldan pa'o// dang po yi ni dang pa ka ོ la// 'og tu me yi sa bo ra na sbyin// dbyangs yig gsum pa i dang ldan pa'o// bzhi pa yi ni dang po ta la// dbyangs yig gnyis pa ā dang ldan pa'o// bzhi pa yi ni lnga pa na ni// mkhas pa yis ni lan gnyis na brjod// thog mar rnam par snang mdza oṃ da sbyin// sde tshan bdun gyi sa ba ha ོna la// dbyangs yig drug pa yū dang ldan pa// spyi bo ru ni thigaṃ les brgyan// lnga pa yi ni gnyis pa pha dang*// gsum pa yi ni dang pa ṭa ོ'o// 'di ni sngags kyi rgyal po ste// ma he'i gdong can sbyor ba yis// thams cad las ni byed pa'o// las kyi sngags su grags pa ste// gsum 'bum bzlas na las kun byed// ces pa'o// gsum pa snying po btu ba ni/ sngar bzhin bri gzhi'i nang du// drug pa yi ni dang po ya dang*// lnga pa yi yang lnga pa la ma // dbyangs yig gnyis pa ā dang sbyar ba// bzhi pa'i lnga na pas brten par bya// bzhi pa'i dang ta po 'og tu bzhag /dang po yi ni dang ka po dang*// thog mar rnam par snang mdza oṃ da sbyin// sde tshan bdun gyi tha ma ha la// dbyangs yig drug pa ū dang ldan par// dran pa de bzhin mthar sbyin no// stong pa'i lhaṃ yis mnyam mnan pa// lnga pa yi ni gnyis pa pha dang*// gsum pa yi ni dang ṭa po'o// 'di ni ma he'i gdong pa yi// snying po'i sngags su rab tu grags// yi ge re re 'bum bzlas pas// 'jig rten gsum gyi las ni gang*// ci yang rung ba thams cad byed// ces pa'o/

de nas man ngag ltar lte bar hūm̐ bris la/ btu gzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du mañji'i khar gzhag go /gsum pa btus pa'i sngags byin gyis brlabs nas mchod pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang btus pa'i yi ge rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i gshin rje'i gshed la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi yon tan dang*/ btu gzhi'i byin rlabs thams cad rtsa sngags las sngags snying po'i sngags kyi yi ge'i rnam par spyan drang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ btus pa'i yi ge rnams la thim pas/ kha dog mthing nag bkrag mdangs dang ldan cing 'od zer dmar po 'phro bar gyur par bsams te/ dpon slob gnyis kas/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā'i bar gyis mchod do// bzhi pa sngags kyi rjes gnang bya tshul ni/ dpon slob gnyis ka lhan cig tu bskyed pa'am/ yang na slob ma rnams hrīḥṣ+ṭiḥs bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba dang nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las slob ma rnams dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po sku mdog mthing nag zhal dgu/ zhes pa nas/ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ yig mthing ga 'od zer lnga 'phro ba/ de'i mig gnyis su k+ṣiṃ zhes pa nas/ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur ces pa'i bar gyis bskyed/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis btus pa'i sngags gsum spyan drangs pa zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i mthar ya mān+ta ka de'i mthar hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥ de'i mthar ya ma rā dzā rnams g.yas skor du 'khod par gyur par dpon slob gnyis kas bsam/ slob mas/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyis// bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i sngags phreng las mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du sngags phreng 'od zer dang bcas pa byung ba zhal nas thon/

slob ma'i kha nas zhugs/ snying gar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i mthar phyin nas rim bzhin g.yas skor du 'khod par bsams la/ rtsa sngags/ las sngags/ snying po rnams kyi rjes zlos lan gsum mam/ bdun nam/ nyer gcig re bya/ bla mas me tog gtor ba dang bcas/ bcom ldan bdag gis sbyin lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la 'jug par gyur cig ces brjod cing bsam/ bla mas sngags rnams zlo bzhin du nang mchod dang g.yon pa'i srin lag gis btus pa'i sngags rnams bkrus pa slob ma rnams la 'thung du bcug pas dpal rdau rje 'jigs byed chen po'i sngags kyi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad thob par bsam/ yang btu gzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbyangs gsal rnams la srin lag gis byugs nas slob ma'i mgrin par thig le byas pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi gsung gi yon tan thams cad thim pas ngag nus pa dang ldan par bsam mo// gsum pa mjug chog ni/ 'das ma 'das kyi lha la gtor 'bul/ tshogs 'khor/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal/ smon lam/ shis brjod rnams rgyas bsdus skabs dang bstun pa bya'o// smras pa/ rgyud kyi ston pas gsungs pa'i gsang sngags kyang*// legs par btus shing mchod de rjes bstan na// ngag gi nus mthu 'bum du 'gyur ro zhes// tshad ldan dam pa'i gzhung du bsngags mthong nas// dus dgra'i dbang po'i rtsa sngags las sngags dang*// snying po'i sngags rnams dag cing ma 'khrugs par// rgyud dang rgya bod bla ma'i man ngag bzhin// btus nas rjes gnang bya tshul gsal bar bgyis// de yis bdag dang mkha' mnyam yid can kun// nges 'byung byang sems yang dag lta ba dang*// rim gnyis lam bzang myur bar bgrod nas ni// bden gnyis zung 'jug go 'phang mngon gyur shog /ces dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i sngags btu'i rjes gnang bya tshul rab gsal sgron me zhes bya ba 'di ni 'brong rtse lha sras rje'i gsung la gzhi byas/

rgyud dang man ngag gis gsal bar byas te/ dge slong dharma bha dras mdzes byed kyi lo'i chu stod zla ba'i yar tshes bzang por bzhad dngul chu'i ri phug tu sbyar ba'o// ༈ /na mo badz+ra bhai ra wā ya/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi tshogs mchod ni/ sha chang tshogs gtor sogs bshams pa byin gyis brlabs te 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ bde skyong stong gsum ltar yangs ka pā lar// dam rdzas bdud rtsi rab 'khyil tshogs mchod 'di// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams mnyes phyir 'bul// bzhes nas sgo gsum byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ āḥgu ru badz+ra dha ra sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra khā hi/ pañca a mṛ ta khā hi/ hūm̐/ bde skyong= dam rdzas= 'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// bzhes nas mchog thun dngos grub stsal du gsol// oṃ āḥbadz+ra bhai ra wa sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra khā hi/ pañca a mṛ ta khā hi/ hūm̐/ bde skyong= dam rdzas= /dkon mchog rin chen tshogs rnams mnyes phyir 'bul// bzhes nas srid zhi'i 'jigs las bsgral du gsol// oṃ āḥrat+na tra ya sa pa ri wā raḥ hūm̐/ bde skyong= dam rdzas= /mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs rnams mnyes= /bzhes nas rnal 'byor phrin las bsgrub tu gsol// oṃ āḥḍā ki nī dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra/ hūm̐/ bde skyong= dam rdzas= /mar gyur rigs drug tshogs rnams mnyes= /bzhes nas 'khrul snang sdug bsngal zhi gyur cig /oṃ āḥṣaṭa ku la a rāḥg ṇa tsakra khā hi/ pañca a mṛ ta khā hi/ de nas las kyi rdo rjes phyag phul la bza' btung lag tu thogs te/ hoḥ dpa' bo chen po dgongs su gsol// 'di la the tshom mi bya ste// bram ze khyi dang gdol pa gsum// dbyer med gcig tu dgongs te rol// zhes phul/ len pa po rnams kyis kyang*/ hūm̐/ bdag nyid rgyal ba kun gyi gtso// bcom ldan rdo rje 'jigs byed dngos// ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho che// lha rnams tshim par bya phyir rol// a ho ma hā su kha/

zhes brjod nas nang gi sbyin sreg gi tshul du rol/ de nas tshogs lhag bsdus pa gong ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ hūm̐ bde skyong= dam rdzas bdud rtsi rab 'khyil tshogs lhag 'di// dam can zhing skyong tshogs rnams mnyes= /bzhes nas 'gal rkyen kun sol mthun rkyen sgrubs// oṃ āḥk+ṣe tra pā la sa pa ri wā ra= ma hā pañca a mṛ ta zhes brjod par bya'o/ /'di'ang dharma bha dras chu yos zla ba drug pa'i tshes nyer bzhi la sbyar ba'o/// / 'di nang 'khor lo khag gnyis 'dug pa bri ma thub/ ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
